instructions.text: Make a rich, brittle crust, with which cover your patty-pans, smoothing off the edges nicely and bake well.
While these shells are cooling, take one teacupful of perfectly sweet and fresh cream, skimmed free of milk; put this into a large bowl or other deep dish.
With your egg-beater whip it to a thick, stiff froth.
Add a heaping tablespoonful of fine white sugar, with a teaspoonful of lemon or vanilla.
Fill the cold shells with this and set in a cool place till tea is ready.

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Make a rich, brittle crust, with which cover your patty-pans, smoothing off the edges nicely and bake well.
2. While these shells are cooling, take one teacupful of perfectly sweet and fresh cream, skimmed free of milk; put this into a large bowl or other deep dish.
3. With your egg-beater whip it to a thick, stiff froth.
4. Add a heaping tablespoonful of fine white sugar, with a teaspoonful of lemon or vanilla.
5. Fill the cold shells with this and set in a cool place till tea is ready.
